lead: Jasprit Bumrah has built a public profile as an Indian cricketer, born on 6 December 1993 in Ahmedabad.
As of 2026, he is 32 years old, and his birth date places him under the Sagittarius sign.
He has represented India national cricket team and Gujarat cricket team and has been recognised with the Wisden Cricketer of the Year.
